content.json:
# Email and Phishing

Defender for Office 365 data, following a malicious message through its life: arrival and verdict
(**Overview**), the user's click (**Clicks**), and what happened after delivery, including mailbox
rules that forward or hide mail (**After delivery**).

The number to watch is **Threat mail delivered**: messages the filter identified as phishing or
malware that still reached a mailbox, usually because an allow list or override let them through.

**Tables read:** `EmailEvents`, `UrlClickEvents`, `EmailPostDeliveryEvents`, `CloudAppEvents`. A tile or chart for a table you do not collect shows an error; the rest still works.

content.query:
EmailEvents
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| summarize Messages = count(),
            Phishing = countif(ThreatTypes has "Phish"),
            Malware = countif(ThreatTypes has "Malware"),
            Spam = countif(ThreatTypes has "Spam"),
            DeliveredThreats = countif(ThreatTypes has_any ("Phish", "Malware") and DeliveryAction == "Delivered"),
            Blocked = countif(DeliveryAction == "Blocked"),
            Targeted = dcountif(RecipientEmailAddress, ThreatTypes has_any ("Phish", "Malware"))
| project Tiles = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Inbound messages", "Value", Messages),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Phishing", "Value", Phishing),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Malware", "Value", Malware),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Spam", "Value", Spam),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Threat mail delivered", "Value", DeliveredThreats),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Messages blocked", "Value", Blocked),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Recipients sent phishing or malware", "Value", Targeted))
| mv-expand Tile = Tiles
| project Metric = tostring(Tile.Metric), Value = tolong(Tile.Value)
content.title: Inbound mail in the time range
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
EmailEvents
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound" and isnotempty(ThreatTypes)
| extend Threat = case(ThreatTypes has "Malware", "Malware", ThreatTypes has "Phish", "Phishing", ThreatTypes has "Spam", "Spam", "Other")
| summarize Messages = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Threat
content.title: Threat mail over time
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
EmailEvents
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound" and ThreatTypes has_any ("Phish", "Malware")
| summarize Messages = count() by Outcome = strcat(DeliveryAction, " (", DeliveryLocation, ")")
content.title: What happened to phishing and malware mail
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
EmailEvents
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound" and ThreatTypes has_any ("Phish", "Malware")
| summarize ThreatMessages = count(),
            Phishing = countif(ThreatTypes has "Phish"),
            Malware = countif(ThreatTypes has "Malware"),
            Delivered = countif(DeliveryAction == "Delivered"),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Recipient = RecipientEmailAddress
| top 50 by ThreatMessages desc
content.title: Most targeted recipients
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
EmailEvents
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound" and ThreatTypes has_any ("Phish", "Malware")
| summarize ThreatMessages = count(),
            Recipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress),
            Delivered = countif(DeliveryAction == "Delivered"),
            ExampleSubject = take_any(Subject),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by SenderDomain = SenderFromDomain
| top 50 by ThreatMessages desc
content.title: Sender domains of phishing and malware
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
EmailEvents
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound" and ThreatTypes has_any ("Phish", "Malware") and DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
| project TimeGenerated,
          Recipient = RecipientEmailAddress,
          Sender = SenderFromAddress,
          Subject,
          Threat = ThreatTypes,
          Location = DeliveryLocation,
          OrgOverride = strcat(OrgLevelAction, " ", OrgLevelPolicy),
          UserOverride = strcat(UserLevelAction, " ", UserLevelPolicy),
          NetworkMessageId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Threat mail that was delivered, and the policy that allowed it
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
UrlClickEvents
| summarize Clicks = count(),
            Malicious = countif(isnotempty(ThreatTypes)),
            Reached = countif(isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and (ActionType == "ClickAllowed" or IsClickedThrough == true)),
            Stopped = countif(ActionType startswith "ClickBlocked" and coalesce(IsClickedThrough, false) == false),
            Users = dcountif(AccountUpn, isnotempty(ThreatTypes))
| project Tiles = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Clicks", "Value", Clicks),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Clicks on malicious URLs", "Value", Malicious),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Malicious pages reached", "Value", Reached),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Clicks blocked", "Value", Stopped),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Users who clicked a malicious URL", "Value", Users))
| mv-expand Tile = Tiles
| project Metric = tostring(Tile.Metric), Value = tolong(Tile.Value)
content.title: Safe Links clicks in the time range
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
UrlClickEvents
| where isnotempty(ThreatTypes)
| summarize Clicks = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Action = ActionType
content.title: Clicks on malicious URLs over time, by what Safe Links did
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
UrlClickEvents
| where isnotempty(ThreatTypes)
| project TimeGenerated,
          Account = AccountUpn,
          Url,
          Threat = ThreatTypes,
          Action = ActionType,
          ReachedPage = ActionType == "ClickAllowed" or coalesce(IsClickedThrough, false),
          Workload,
          Address = IPAddress,
          NetworkMessageId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Clicks on malicious URLs
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
EmailPostDeliveryEvents
| summarize Messages = count(), Recipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Type = ActionType, Action, Result = ActionResult
| order by Messages desc
content.title: Actions on mail after delivery
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
EmailPostDeliveryEvents
| where ActionType has "ZAP" or ActionType has "remediation"
| project TimeGenerated,
          Recipient = RecipientEmailAddress,
          Sender = SenderFromAddress,
          Type = ActionType,
          Action,
          Result = ActionResult,
          Threat = ThreatTypes,
          NetworkMessageId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Messages removed after delivery
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType in~ ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule")
| mv-apply Parameter = RawEventData.Parameters on (
    summarize Settings = make_bag(bag_pack(tostring(Parameter.Name), tostring(Parameter.Value))))
| project TimeGenerated,
          Account = tostring(RawEventData.UserId),
          Operation = ActionType,
          RuleName = tostring(Settings.Name),
          ForwardsTo = coalesce(tostring(Settings.ForwardTo), tostring(Settings.ForwardAsAttachmentTo), tostring(Settings.RedirectTo)),
          MovesTo = tostring(Settings.MoveToFolder),
          Deletes = tostring(Settings.DeleteMessage),
          Address = IPAddress,
          Country = CountryCode
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Inbox rules created or changed
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.json: These are the detection rules in this repository for this area (`Detection-rules/` in SentinelWork). A rule with 0 alerts is either not deployed, not enabled, or has had nothing to report in the time range. Alerts are matched to rules by name, so a rule you rename in Sentinel stops being counted here. Incidents are matched by rule name or by the rule's identifier, so they survive a rename.

content.query:
let Rules = datatable(RuleId:string, AlertName:string, RuleSeverity:string, Tactics:string) [
    "EM-001", "User clicked through to a malicious URL", "High", "InitialAccess",
    "EM-002", "Phishing or malware email delivered to several recipients", "Medium", "InitialAccess",
    "EM-003", "Inbox rule or mailbox setting that forwards, deletes or hides mail", "Medium", "Collection, DefenseEvasion",
    "EM-004", "Recipient clicked a link in mail that was later removed as malicious", "High", "InitialAccess"
];
let AlertCounts = SecurityAlert
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName) by SystemAlertId
    | summarize AlertCount = count(), LastAlert = max(TimeGenerated) by AlertName;
Rules
| join kind=leftouter AlertCounts on AlertName
| project RuleId, Rule = AlertName, Severity = RuleSeverity, Tactics, Alerts = coalesce(AlertCount, 0), LastAlert
| order by RuleId asc
content.title: Rule coverage
content.noDataMessage: No rules are defined for this area.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["User clicked through to a malicious URL", "Phishing or malware email delivered to several recipients", "Inbox rule or mailbox setting that forwards, deletes or hides mail", "Recipient clicked a link in mail that was later removed as malicious"]);
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName in (RuleNames)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName) by SystemAlertId
| summarize Alerts = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), AlertName
content.title: Alerts over time, by rule
content.noDataMessage: None of these rules raised an alert in the time range.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["User clicked through to a malicious URL", "Phishing or malware email delivered to several recipients", "Inbox rule or mailbox setting that forwards, deletes or hides mail", "Recipient clicked a link in mail that was later removed as malicious"]);
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName in (RuleNames)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| project TimeGenerated, Rule = AlertName, Severity = AlertSeverity, Status,
          Details = tostring(parse_json(ExtendedProperties)["Custom Details"]), Entities
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Latest alerts
content.noDataMessage: None of these rules raised an alert in the time range.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["User clicked through to a malicious URL", "Phishing or malware email delivered to several recipients", "Inbox rule or mailbox setting that forwards, deletes or hides mail", "Recipient clicked a link in mail that was later removed as malicious"]);
let RuleIds = dynamic(["fe084df5-e336-5cc2-aa3c-14b2ca5392fa", "3283f45d-5e7c-5c14-b082-92d089b69086", "4c2d3dd2-de54-5677-a14d-6577a2016a7c", "1e3eb5d7-e2e7-5fdf-b100-b5dbab56e901"]);
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Title in (RuleNames) or tostring(RelatedAnalyticRuleIds) has_any (RuleIds)
| extend LabelText = tostring(Labels)
| project CreatedTime, IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Classification,
          AssignedTo = tostring(Owner.assignedTo),
          AgentDisposition = extract(@"soc-agent:(page|queue|auto_close|pending)", 1, LabelText), IncidentUrl
| order by CreatedTime desc
| take 250
content.title: Incidents created by these rules
content.noDataMessage: No incidents from these rules in the time range.
